script.description:
Split Event 4103 event data fields.
ContextInfo is a block of "<Key> = <Value>" lines indented by at least eight spaces.
A value can span several lines, and those lines can themselves be indented, for example
when 'Host Application' holds a multi-line script passed to powershell.exe -Command.
A KV processor splits on those indented lines and then fails on the ones that hold no
key/value separator, so a line is treated as a new key only when it has eight or more
leading spaces and matches the key pattern. Anything else is appended to the previous value.
Parse failures are recorded on error.message without stopping the rest of the pipeline,
including the @custom pipeline that Fleet adds.
Remove spaces from all event_data keys.
Remove all empty values from event_data.

script.description: Compute Shannon entropy of script block text using Unicode character distribution. Entropy (0-20 bits) measures randomness; surprisal_stdev measures distribution uniformity.

Parses all command invocation detail raw lines, and converts them to an object, based on their type.
 - for unexpectedly formatted ones: {value: "the raw line as it is"}
 - for all:
      * related_command: describes to what command it is related to
      * value: the value for that detail line
      * type: the type of the detail line, i.e.: CommandInvocation, ParameterBinding, NonTerminatingError
 - additionally, ParameterBinding adds a `name` field with the parameter name being bound.
